description: The Union Registry is the European Commission's online database that accounts for every allowance issued under the EU Emissions Trading System, tracking ownership in electronic accounts and whether operators report their emissions and surrender allowances. Since 2012 it has been a single registry for all participating countries, holding accounts for stationary installations (transferred from the earlier national registries), aircraft operators since January 2012 and maritime operators since January 2024. Public information on the registry website includes the national implementation measures (the list of installations covered in each country with their free allocation), free allocation, annual verified emissions and compliance status of operators, account holders and transactions; historical national allocation plan tables for 2008 to 2012 are also linked. Access is free on the Commission's pages and the registry's public reports, published in the EU languages; no separate licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: data are per installation or operator account, not per site, installation identifiers must be matched to other registers, and the registry's own public reports were not opened for this record. For simulation it gives the list and yearly emissions of large energy-intensive industrial installations for scenarios of decarbonisation, carbon cost exposure and capacity planning. Related catalogue records include the European Industrial Emissions Portal, whose download page also offers the EU ETS dataset.
